summary: @ornikar/lerna-config preinstall hook drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: Version 11.0.2 of @ornikar/lerna-config declares a preinstall lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, and then invokes the freshly downloaded runtime to execute the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is ~727 KB of heavily obfuscated JavaScript (rotated string array, `_0xXXXX` identifiers, encoded charset table) that has no relation to the package's stated purpose (a Lerna configuration helper). package.json advertises a benign index.js entry, but the preinstall + Bun-runtime + obfuscated math_init.js are grafted onto that legitimate-looking library, resulting in automatic execution of opaque code on the installer's host at install time. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern here is used to run bundled attacker-controlled code rather than to install an official runtime for the package's own use.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
